dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: はいよろしくお願いしますはじめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. May we begin?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ではよろしくお願いします本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: All right, thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 何を話してもいいんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay to talk about anything?

dialogue.content: はいどうぞ
dialogue.English: Yes, please go ahead.

dialogue.content: このところ、コロナの影響で仕事がだいぶ減ってまして
dialogue.English: Lately, my work has decreased significantly due to the impact of COVID-19.

dialogue.content: はい大変ですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 営業なので、ダイレクトに自分の収入にも影響があるのですが
dialogue.English: I’m in sales, so it directly affects my income.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・それは苦しいですね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be painful.

dialogue.content: あまり減るとローンの残っている家を手放さないといけなくなるんです
dialogue.English: If it decreases too much, I'll have to give up our house, which still has a mortgage.

dialogue.content: えっ？それは、まずいですよね
dialogue.English: Oh? That's a very serious situation, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: それで困っていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: So that's what's been troubling you.

dialogue.content: それは切羽詰まってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That must make you feel really cornered.

dialogue.content: それだけではなくて
dialogue.English: And it’s not just that.

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 仕事をがんばれば挽回できると思っていたのですが
dialogue.English: I thought I could make up for it by working hard, but...

dialogue.content: はいそう思いますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's a natural way to think.

dialogue.content: 1ヶ月前にうつと診断されてしまって、、
dialogue.English: But a month ago, I was diagnosed with depression...

dialogue.content: そうだったのですか・・・それは・・
dialogue.English: Is that so... That must have been...

dialogue.content: 本来なら会社を休むべきと言われまして、でも妻の手前休めずに
dialogue.English: I was told I should ideally take time off work, but I haven’t been able to, because of my wife.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか？それは、苦しいですよね
dialogue.English: Is that right? That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 今でも出勤してまして、部長になってからどうも部下と上手くいかなくなってしまい
dialogue.English: I’m still going in to work, and ever since I became a department manager, things haven’t been going well with my subordinates.

dialogue.content: どうにも。。。
dialogue.English: I just can’t seem to manage...

dialogue.content: そうなのですか・・・部下とも
dialogue.English: I see... with your subordinates as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いろいろなことが重なってしまって・・・どうしてよいかわからないでよね
dialogue.English: So many things have piled up... It must be hard to know what to do.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず体調ですが今はどのようなかんじでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: First, how are you feeling physically right now?

dialogue.content: 何もやる気が出ないです
dialogue.English: I have no motivation to do anything.

dialogue.content: 家族とも何を話していいのかわからない
dialogue.English: I don't even know what to say to my family.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねそれでは、仕事など部下のこともご家族とも話ができていないのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you haven't been able to talk about your work, your subordinates, or other things with your family.

dialogue.content: それはつらいですよね
dialogue.English: That must be painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 妻は金遣いが荒いんです
dialogue.English: My wife spends money recklessly.

dialogue.content: えっ？？
dialogue.English: Oh?

dialogue.content: それは、大変ですよね
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: だから家を売らないといけない状況なんて考えてもいない
dialogue.English: So she hasn’t even considered that we might have to sell the house.

dialogue.content: 今のあなたのご事情もわかられていないと・・・
dialogue.English: So she isn’t aware of your current situation...

dialogue.content: 全く会話がないので
dialogue.English: We don't talk at all.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか・・それでは、あなたがどんどん追い込まれてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see... that would leave you feeling more and more cornered.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しかし仕事がうまくいかないのは私に責任があります
dialogue.English: But it's my responsibility that work isn't going well.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか？
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: どのような思いがあるのですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 収入が減るのは自分の責任です
dialogue.English: The decrease in income is my own fault.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね
dialogue.English: That’s how you see it.

dialogue.content: 子育ては妻に任せきりだったし
dialogue.English: I've left child-rearing entirely to my wife.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね気にされているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. That’s something that weighs on you.

dialogue.content: 自業自得です
dialogue.English: It's my own fault.

dialogue.content: そこまで疲れ切ってしまっていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: You must be completely exhausted to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: うつ病と診断されたとのことですが治療はどのような感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned being diagnosed with depression. What does your treatment look like?

dialogue.content: 先生には休めていないことをお伝えできているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to tell your doctor that you haven’t been able to rest?

dialogue.content: はい、眠れるように睡眠導入薬を出してもらってます
dialogue.English: Yes, they've prescribed sleeping pills to help me sleep.

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: でも薬は飲んでません
dialogue.English: But I’m not taking the medication.

dialogue.content: えっ？それでは、眠れていない？
dialogue.English: What? So, you haven't been sleeping?

dialogue.content: はい、まぁ
dialogue.English: Yes, well...

dialogue.content: まずいですよねそれでは体調が回復できないですよね
dialogue.English: That's not good, is it? You won't be able to recover your health that way.

dialogue.content: 多少は寝れてます
dialogue.English: I'm managing to sleep a little.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・どのような思いがあってお薬を飲まないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... what are your thoughts behind not taking the medication?

dialogue.content: 先生にはそのこともお伝えできていない感じですか？
dialogue.English: And it sounds like you haven’t told your doctor about that either?

dialogue.content: まとめて飲めば死ねるかと
dialogue.English: I thought maybe if I took them all at once, I could die.

dialogue.content: ・・・・・その様にお考えなのですね・・・
dialogue.English: ...So that's what you've been thinking...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのくらい追いつめられたお気持ちなのですね
dialogue.English: You’re feeling that cornered.

dialogue.content: 自分が死んだら家も家族に残りますしね
dialogue.English: If I die, the house will be left for my family.

dialogue.content: それでもご家族のことをお思いなのですね・・・
dialogue.English: Even then, you're still thinking about your family...

dialogue.content: ええそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Yes, maybe so.

dialogue.content: お子様のことはどのようにおもっていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about your children?

dialogue.content: もう中学生と高校生で男2人なので
dialogue.English: They’re already in junior high and high school—two boys—so...

dialogue.content: 勝手にやってますよ
dialogue.English: They pretty much do their own thing.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 何を考えてるか全くわからない
dialogue.English: I have no idea what they’re thinking.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねわかりにくくなってしまう年頃ですよね
dialogue.English: I understand—it’s an age when they can be hard to read.

dialogue.content: だから会話もないし…
dialogue.English: So we don’t really talk...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 寂しい感じもしますよね
dialogue.English: That must feel lonely, too.

dialogue.content: ええ、でも仕方ないです
dialogue.English: Yeah, but it is what it is.

dialogue.content: 仕事人間でしたから
dialogue.English: Because I've been a workaholic.

dialogue.content: 部長になられていらっしゃるということはかなりやってこられたのですよね
dialogue.English: The fact that you became a department manager means you must have worked very hard.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 部下とうまくいっていないと先ほどおっしゃっていましたが
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that things aren’t going well with your subordinates.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それはどのようなことがおありなのですか？
dialogue.English: What sort of things have been happening?

dialogue.content: うーん言葉が通じない感じ、ですかね
dialogue.English: Hmm... it feels like we’re not speaking the same language, I guess.

dialogue.content: そうなのですかそれは、やりずらいですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must make things difficult.

dialogue.content: 指示を出してもスッと理解してくれないというか
dialogue.English: It's like, even when I give instructions, they don't grasp them right away.

dialogue.content: はいそれは都度引っかかってしまうのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So it's a stumbling block each time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのような部下に仕事をさせるのはぐったりしてしまいますね
dialogue.English: Having to get work done with subordinates like that must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: その部下とはいつからお仕事されているのですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been working with these subordinates?

dialogue.content: 3月に昇進してからです
dialogue.English: Since my promotion in March.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですねそれでコロナ・・・・本当に重なってしまってますね
dialogue.English: I see—and then COVID... everything really hit at once.

dialogue.content: そこへコロナで
dialogue.English: And then COVID on top of that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: 一人で抱え込んでしまわれた感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel like you've been shouldering all of this by yourself?

dialogue.content: そうですね。割と昇進が早いので
dialogue.English: I suppose so. I was promoted relatively quickly.

dialogue.content: お若いのですね
dialogue.English: You're young, then.

dialogue.content: 40です
部下と言っても年上もいて
dialogue.English: And even though they're my subordinates, some are older than me.

dialogue.content: それはお若い余計に立場が難しいかもですね
dialogue.English: Being younger, that can make your position even more challenging.

dialogue.content: ええ…
dialogue.English: Yeah...

dialogue.content: 指示もしにくいですよね
dialogue.English: It must be hard to give instructions.

dialogue.content: また、聞いてくれなそうな・・・
dialogue.English: And it can feel like they won’t listen...

dialogue.content: それなりに工夫しようとは考えていましたが
dialogue.English: I've been trying to think of ways to handle it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 判断を迫られる場面も多くて
dialogue.English: There are also many situations where I'm forced to make a decision.

dialogue.content: 判断・・・
dialogue.English: Decisions...

dialogue.content: なかなか仕事自体も減ってきましたしね…
dialogue.English: And the amount of work itself has been decreasing...

dialogue.content: あーそうですよねそもそもコロナ・・・
dialogue.English: Ah, right. Because of COVID in the first place...

dialogue.content: はい働けないのも辛いです
dialogue.English: Yes, not being able to work is painful too.

dialogue.content: やりたくてもできないほど、つらいものはないですよね
dialogue.English: There's nothing quite as painful as wanting to do something but not being able to.

dialogue.content: ええうまくいかないもんです
dialogue.English: Yeah, nothing’s going right.

dialogue.content: 本当になぜ今？と思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: You can’t help but think, ‘Why now?’

dialogue.content: そうですねー。日本ではそんなに死者も出てないのに
dialogue.English: Right. It’s not like there have been that many deaths in Japan.

dialogue.content: 自粛自粛で
dialogue.English: It’s been constant calls for self-restraint.

dialogue.content: はいそうですよね・・・自粛ばかりでは会社が持たないですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right... With all these restrictions, companies can't survive.

dialogue.content: 焦ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: こんなに気持ちがあるのに・・・悔しいですよね
dialogue.English: To have all this drive... it must be so frustrating.

dialogue.content: …はい
dialogue.English: ...Yes.

dialogue.content: ここまでのところ一旦まとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I take a moment to summarize what I’ve heard so far?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 3月より部長に昇進した矢先にコロナに巻き込まれ収入が減ってしまう状況
dialogue.English: You were promoted to department manager in March, and right after that COVID hit, reducing your income.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 部下も理解力が低くまた、年齢も上のこともありやり取りがうまくいかない
dialogue.English: Your subordinates have difficulty understanding things, and with some being older, communication is not going smoothly.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までお仕事一筋だったこともありご家庭とは会話が少なく
dialogue.English: Because you've been so dedicated to your work, you have little conversation with your family.

dialogue.content: はいありません
dialogue.English: Yes, none at all.

dialogue.content: 奥様も金銭の使い方が荒く
dialogue.English: Your wife spends money recklessly,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: このままではローンに支払いができないため住宅をあきらめなければならないと考えていらっしゃる
dialogue.English: You're thinking that at this rate, you won't be able to make the mortgage payments and will have to give up your home.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 1ヵ月前にうつ病と診断されたが仕事を休むこともできず家族にも相談できていない
dialogue.English: You were diagnosed with depression a month ago, but you can't take time off from work and haven't been able to talk to your family about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 睡眠薬をいただいているが飲まずにいらしている
dialogue.English: You've been prescribed sleeping medication but are not taking it.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: 多量に飲むと死ねるのではないかとそうすれば家が守れるのではないかとお考えになっている
dialogue.English: You're thinking that if you took a large dose, you might be able to die, and that way, you could protect your home.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: この20年近くをお仕事に捧げてこられ、結果と認められ昇進したところでこのコロナの時代に突入してしまい
dialogue.English: You've dedicated nearly 20 years to your work, and just when you were recognized for your results with a promotion, this coronavirus era began.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今まで責任を果たされてこれたあなたとしてはとてもやりきれなく苦しい思いでいっぱいだと思います
dialogue.English: For you, who has always fulfilled your responsibilities, I imagine you're filled with an unbearable sense of frustration and pain.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご家族との会話がないのもお若いのに必死でご家族を守るためにお仕事してきたからこそだと思います
dialogue.English: I believe the lack of conversation with your family is precisely because you've worked so desperately from a young age to protect them.

dialogue.content: 責任感がつよく、行動力もあり、今も、体調が悪いのに仕事とご家庭のことを優先しいらっしゃる
dialogue.English: You have a strong sense of responsibility and initiative, and even now, despite not feeling well, you’re prioritizing work and your family.

dialogue.content: ほんとうによく頑張られていることが目に浮かびました
dialogue.English: I can clearly see how hard you've been working.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: もう少しお話伺ってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I ask a bit more?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様にお話しできないとおっしゃっていますがそれはどのような思いがあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You said you can’t talk to your wife—what feelings are behind that?

dialogue.content: そうですね…自分がありえない状態で
dialogue.English: Well... I’m in a state that feels unacceptable.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 怒られそうなのと失望させるのと
dialogue.English: I’m afraid she’ll get angry and be disappointed,

dialogue.content: 両方が怖いのかもしれません
dialogue.English: maybe I’m afraid of both.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・その様にお考えなのですね
dialogue.English: I see... that's how you're thinking about it.

dialogue.content: 話したら終わりそうな
dialogue.English: It feels like if I tell her, it’ll be the end.

dialogue.content: 怒られたり失望されるというのはとても怖く感じてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Being met with anger or disappointment can feel very frightening.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 終わりそうだと考えると恐ろしくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: The thought that it might be the end is terrifying.

dialogue.content: そのくらい奥様のことをお思いでいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: That shows how much you care about your wife.

dialogue.content: 自分のイメージが壊れるのがイヤなんです
dialogue.English: I hate the idea of my image being shattered.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねご自身が作ってきたものがありますものね
dialogue.English: I understand. You have an image of yourself that you've built up.

dialogue.content: 大切ですよね
dialogue.English: That's important.

dialogue.content: イメージが壊れるというのは誰からのイメージとお考えなのですか？
dialogue.English: When you say shattering your image, whose perception of you are you thinking about?

dialogue.content: 妻が求める自分ではないと認めたくないんですかね。
dialogue.English: Maybe I don’t want to admit I’m not the person my wife expects me to be.

dialogue.content: そんなにまで奥様のことが・・・
dialogue.English: You care that much about your wife...

dialogue.content: 好きとかもう無いですよ
dialogue.English: It’s not like I love her anymore.

dialogue.content: プライドですかね
dialogue.English: It's my pride, I guess.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 本来なら金銭の使い方が悪い奥様に否があると思われるのですが・・・
dialogue.English: Normally, one might think your wife, with her spending habits, is the one at fault...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたはそのことについてどのようにお考えでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: What are your thoughts on that matter?

dialogue.content: そんな妻をいいよって言ってきたのも私ですからね
dialogue.English: I'm the one who's always said it was okay for her to be that way.

dialogue.content: 稼げばいいと思ってましたから
dialogue.English: I always thought I just had to earn enough.

dialogue.content: いいよと言ってきたのですねはい稼げばと・・・・
dialogue.English: You told her it was okay, thinking you just had to earn more...

dialogue.content: 死にたいというお気持ちについてはどのような感じですか？
dialogue.English: Regarding your feelings of wanting to die, how are they now?

dialogue.content: 薬を飲んで死ねば片が付くと思ってましたけど
dialogue.English: I thought if I took the medicine and died, it would solve everything.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今、いろいろ聞いてもらって
dialogue.English: But now, after you've listened to me...

dialogue.content: 少し冷静になっています
dialogue.English: I'm feeling a little calmer.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうですかそれははい
dialogue.English: I see—that’s good to hear.

dialogue.content: お薬は今どのようになっていますか？
dialogue.English: Where is the medication now?

dialogue.content: 書斎にありますね
dialogue.English: It's in my study.

dialogue.content: 書斎なんですね・・・
dialogue.English: In your study...

dialogue.content: 私の提案を一つ聞いていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Would you be willing to hear a suggestion from me?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 銀行に行って住宅ローンのご相談をしてみていただきたいです
dialogue.English: I'd like you to try going to the bank to discuss your home loan.

dialogue.content: え？…はい
dialogue.English: Oh?... Okay.

dialogue.content: 今はコロナのために個人にも企業にもたくさんの救済措置があります
dialogue.English: Right now, because of the coronavirus, there are many relief measures available for both individuals and companies.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とつぜんですみません
dialogue.English: I’m sorry to bring this up suddenly.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: No, it's fine.

dialogue.content: 今、まず、一つずつ解決できそうなことと思ったのですが
dialogue.English: I was thinking we could start with something that seems solvable, one step at a time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: そこならトライできるかなと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought that might be something you could try.

dialogue.content: …そうですね。やってみます。
dialogue.English: ...You're right. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: これほどまで責任感があり、結果も役職おありな方ですから、銀行さんからは適切に対応いただけると思います
dialogue.English: For someone with such a strong sense of responsibility, who has achieved results and a position like yours, I believe the bank will respond appropriately.

dialogue.content: そうですか？だといいです
dialogue.English: Do you think so? I hope so.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です安心して行かれてください
dialogue.English: You'll be fine. Please go with confidence.

dialogue.content: はい。行ってみます。
dialogue.English: Okay. I'll go.

dialogue.content: お時間が来てしまいましたが今どんなお気持ちですか？まだ、続けましょうか？
dialogue.English: Our time is up, but how are you feeling now? Would you like to continue?

dialogue.content: 続けられますよ
dialogue.English: We can continue if you wish.

dialogue.content: いえ今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for today.

dialogue.content: わかりましたでは、また、連絡お待ちしています
dialogue.English: Understood. I’ll be waiting to hear from you again.

dialogue.content: プライドを守るかその前に家を守ってみます。
dialogue.English: Before I worry about protecting my pride, I'll try to protect my house.

dialogue.content: 家を守れればプライドも守れるかもしれません
dialogue.English: If I can protect the house, maybe I can protect my pride, too.

dialogue.content: また、お願いします
dialogue.English: I'd like to talk again.

dialogue.content: そうですねそこをすっきりさせてからまた一緒に考えましょう
dialogue.English: That sounds good. Let's clear that up, and then we can think about things together again.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。本日はこれで終わりにさせていただきます
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. We'll end our session here.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you!

dialogue.content: （コピペさせていただきたいのでお時間ください）
dialogue.English: (Please give me a moment to copy and paste this.)

dialogue.content: はい承知しました
dialogue.English: Yes, understood.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
